summary: The PR attempts to resolve an issue where `get_feature_names` raises a `NotFittedError` even when the vocabulary is provided. However, the implementation is redundant and may introduce inefficiencies.

issues.description: The PR adds redundant calls to `_validate_vocabulary` within the `get_feature_names` method. This is unnecessary because `_validate_vocabulary` is already called at the beginning of the `fit` method, and the `vocabulary_` attribute is set during initialization when the `vocabulary` parameter is provided.
The additional calls to `_validate_vocabulary` may introduce performance regressions, especially if `get_feature_names` is called frequently without fitting the model.
